newsitem.title: USA: Minntech hurt by oxygenator delay.
newsitem.headline: Minntech hurt by oxygenator delay.

text.p: Minntech Corp said Thursday the delay of U.S. approval for its Biocor oxygenator continued to hurt sales in its cardiosurgery business in the fiscal 1997 third quarter ended December 31.

"As a result, we reduced our workforce by about 10 percent in January in order to bring operating expenses in line with current sales levels," Louis Cosentino, chief executive of the medical device manufacturer, said in a news release.
"We completed all necessary data collection for (the Food and Drug Administration) in early December, and we expect approval of the Biocor before the end of the fiscal year," he said.
Earlier Thursday, Minntech reported net income of $661,000 or $0.10 a share for the third quarter, compared with $1.9 million or $0.27 a share a year ago.
Minntech shares closed unchanged at 11-3/4 Thursday.
